author: Cleo Abram
description:
This is part of your heart on a chip!

Scientists made them by scanning the arteries of real patients, creating a 3D image, and 3D printing it onto a piece of glass.

They’re using it to understand blood clots, make patient-specific treatments, and test new drugs.

To see what happens next subscribe…

DOI: 10.1016/j.celbio.2026.100541 @sydney_uni
